requirements: While mode is blocked_procedural_default, the prepared ORIGINAL v1 bundled loader must not be reachable from src/main.ts.
The live registry must continue to default to the clean procedural character.
The prepared loader may contain only the exact product-relative production paths and must reject arbitrary/candidate/remote paths.
Changing this contract to any activation mode is intentionally unsupported until ORIGINAL_V1_PROMOTION_CONTRACT.json is approved with exact source commit and production hashes.
Activation must be a reviewed code change with runtime/default-character tests, not a configuration-only switch.
note: This contract guards runtime reachability only. It does not approve the model, garment, rig cutover, deformation, grip, offline or physical-device gates.
